memoryRule: two opposing geometry-neutral side offers become a signed counterfield; production regenerates every ribbon and the volume pose, and four productions persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch arms left/right sides; Arrow keys arm equivalent sides; Enter, Space, or produce control commits the pair; Delete lifts latest; R or Escape releases
representationRupture: inline SVG departing syntax clauses, DOM contact print, and Canvas resistance specimen -> browser-native WebGL volume with generated ribbon-panel geometry
compositionRupture: broken sentence, hard-edged contact plate, and vertical cast -> one faceted three-dimensional body with a central void and nested surface planes
encounterRupture: enter-and-leave a clause, select-and-develop a witness, and drag-and-release pressure -> pair two opposing side pressures before a production event
temporalRupture: non-local departure, delayed development, and stored resistance cast -> explicit two-sided offer, global field production, four-step reversible history
mediumRupture: inline SVG path geometry, semantic DOM cell geometry, and Canvas 2D raster -> WebGL shader pipeline and GPU-produced triangle surfaces
changedRule: A left and right pressure remain geometry-neutral until both sides are armed. Their signed difference becomes a counterfield that regenerates every ribbon and the volume's global twist/fold parameters.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a faceted three-dimensional volume of twenty-two ribbon panels. One offer leaves the volume exact; an unequal pair changes all ribbons' curvature, phase, width, depth, and global pose. Four productions remain visible and liftable.
falsifier: Delete if one side alone produces, if an offer changes geometry, if production only changes colour/camera/readout, if the whole field is not regenerated, if the blind volume reads as a generic 3D ribbon sculpture or linefield, or if later productions reset.
deletionCondition: Delete v039 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the counterfield volume from a generic 3D ribbon sculpture or linefield, or if the global production rule is not materially visible.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
